observation.visible_scene: An outdoor grassy field at the foot of a large, misty brown mountain under an overcast sky. A person in a gray puffer jacket, dark leggings and light boots stands holding two long reddish poles whose tips are joined by strings, forming a giant bubble wand. A white bucket sits on the grass to the right. A large soap-bubble film with iridescent rainbow patches is already present in front of the wand at the start of the clip.
visible_changes: The soap film drawn from the wand loop grows from a compact iridescent mass near the strings into a long, irregular sheet extending to the right and downward.
As the film expands, multiple rounded lobes and bulbous protrusions appear along its surface, and the rainbow reflections become broader and more saturated.
The bubble structure drifts progressively to the right, away from the wand, while the loop between the strings is left with only a thin, mostly transparent trailing film.
The person keeps both arms raised holding the poles, with small stance and arm-angle adjustments (poles tilt slightly more backward over time); the body shifts a little leftward within the frame.
The white bucket remains stationary on the ground throughout; the background mountain and sky show a slight leftward drift of features, consistent with a slow camera pan or the person stepping left.
The overall bubble mass increases in size and complexity from frame 1 to frame 41 without visibly popping.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the wand was loaded with solution before the clip began.
Whether the bubble eventually detaches fully, floats away, or pops after the last frame.
The exact moment and mechanism of separation from the wand loop, which is already in progress at the start.
uncertain_details: Whether the leftward shift of the person and bucket relative to the frame is due to camera panning or the person walking; background evidence is limited.
Precise timing of when the film stops being connected to the wand strings versus when it is merely stretched between them.
Whether the lobes are separate small bubbles or folds of one continuous film.
